title.value: Run a Monday competitor-monitoring brief from job listings

introduction.value: Claude is set up as an agent that browses competitors and reads their job listings every Monday morning to infer what they may do next.

method.value: The poster set Claude to run every Monday at 8am with a prompt listing competitors and asking it to check each company’s website for recent activity: pricing changes, new products or features, new content, announcements or press, and job listings that hint at strategy. Claude then summarizes what changed that week across all of them and highlights the single most important item; the person’s role was mainly supplying the competitor list and reading the finished brief.

outcome.value: The stated result is a Monday-morning brief delivered without manual checking or a dashboard, with job listings used to infer likely moves such as a push on distribution. The post gives no measured accuracy, savings, or examples of misses.

notes.value: The only concrete setup detail given is the schedule: it runs every Monday at 8am.

What they did

Claude then summarizes what changed that week across all of them and highlights the single most important item; the person’s role was mainly supplying the competitor list and reading the finished brief.

Try it yourself
with
Claude in Chrome
Copy prompt
Every Monday morning, visit the websites and careers pages of these competitors: [list of competitors]. Read their current job listings and recent announcements, compare them with last week's notes if available, and write a one-page brief on what they might be building or planning next, with evidence quoted from the listings. Finish with 3 bullet-point takeaways for my team in [function], and do not apply to anything or fill in any forms.
